newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CONVINCING N.TVL BEAT E.TVL 72-24.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CONVINCING N.TVL BEAT E.TVL 72-24.

text.p: Northern Transvaal notched up a convincing 72-24 (halftime 25-10) victory over Eastern Transvaal to keep them at te top of their Currie Cup table in Brakpan on Saturday.
Eastern Transvaal - Tries: Jaco Viljoen (2), Eugene Meyer. Conversions: Viljoen (3). Penalty: Viljoen.

Northern Transvaal - Tries: Nicky van der Walt, Willie Enslin, Dawie du Toit, Hannes Venter (2), Conrad Breytenbach (2), F.A. Meiring (2), Thys Scholtz. Conversions: Rynhard van As (8). Penalties: van As (2).
